title: Bubblegum Mage Sequence
description: A four-panel vertical sequence showing a pink-haired female character in green and black armor casting a glowing green spell. She progresses from holding a swirling green orb to releasing a large explosive burst of green magic with bubbles and particles.
prompt: A tough anime girl with bright pink hair in pigtails and a small crown, wearing green and black armored dress with cape and heavy boots, chewing bubblegum. She stands in a dynamic pose casting green magic, holding a swirling green energy orb that grows into a large explosive burst of glowing green bubbles and particles. Four panel vertical sequence showing the spell progression against a solid bright green background, cartoon digital illustration style.
